title: Voltmace Delta 14B/1 KEYPAD driver (© 1983 Custom Video Productions)
notes: Extracted from the Voltmace Delta 14B driver disc (release 1) with oaknut-disc. A *RUN program that loads at &1900 and executes at &3906. Comprises a 6502 keypad-scanning driver (written to run relocated at &0A00) plus a keypad-definition editor written in BBC BASIC, stored ROL-encoded (rotate-left one bit) as rudimentary protection.
